{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeApplications #-}

module UploadService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BSC
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.IORef
import System.IO
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Format
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Char (isPrint, isAlphaNum)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Text.Printf (printf)

-- | Structured log entry for audit trail
data LogLevel = INFO | WARN | ERROR deriving (Show)

data LogEntry = LogEntry
  { logTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , logLevel    :: LogLevel
  , logSource   :: Text
  , logMessage  :: Text
  , logMetadata :: [(Text, Text)]
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Upload request from gRPC proto
data UploadRequest = UploadRequest
  { uploadFilename  :: Text
  , uploadMimeType  :: Text
  , uploadSize      :: Int
  , uploadChecksum  :: Text
  , uploadPayload   :: BS.ByteString
  , uploadRequestId :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

data UploadResponse = UploadResponse
  { responseStatus  :: Int
  , responseMessage :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Sanitize text for safe inclusion in structured fields
-- Removes control characters and limits length
sanitizeField :: Int -> Text -> Text
sanitizeField maxLen input =
  let cleaned = T.filter (\c -> isPrint c && c /= '\\') input
  in T.take maxLen cleaned

-- | Encode metadata value - escapes special characters
encodeMetaValue :: Text -> Text
encodeMetaValue val =
  let escaped = T.concatMap escapeChar val
  in escaped
  where
    escapeChar '"'  = "\\\"" 
    escapeChar '\\' = "\\\\"
    escapeChar c
      | isPrint c = T.singleton c
      | otherwise = T.pack $ printf "\\x%02x" (fromEnum c)

-- | Format a log entry as a single structured log line
formatLogEntry :: LogEntry -> Text
formatLogEntry entry =
  let ts = T.pack $ formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%QZ" (logTimestamp entry)
      lvl = T.pack $ show (logLevel entry)
      src = logSource entry
      msg = logMessage entry
      meta = formatMetadata (logMetadata entry)
  in T.concat ["[", ts, "] [", lvl, "] [", src, "] ", msg, meta, "\n"]

-- | Format metadata as key=value pairs
formatMetadata :: [(Text, Text)] -> Text
formatMetadata [] = ""
formatMetadata pairs =
  let formatted = map (\(k, v) -> T.concat [k, "=\"", v, "\""]) pairs
  in T.concat [" | ", T.intercalate ", " formatted]

-- | Write log entry to the audit log file
writeAuditLog :: Handle -> LogEntry -> IO ()
writeAuditLog h entry = do
  let line = formatLogEntry entry
  BSC.hPutStr h (TE.encodeUtf8 line)
  hFlush h

-- | Validate filename according to security policy
validateFilename :: Text -> Either Text Text
validateFilename name
  | T.null name = Left "empty filename"
  | T.length name > 255 = Left "filename too long"
  | T.any (\c -> c == '/' || c == '\\' || c == '\0') name = Left "invalid characters in filename"
  | otherwise = Right name

-- | Validate MIME type format
validateMimeType :: Text -> Either Text Text
validateMimeType mime
  | T.null mime = Left "empty mime type"
  | not (T.isInfixOf "/" mime) = Left "invalid mime format"
  | T.length mime > 127 = Left "mime type too long"
  | otherwise = Right mime

-- | Core upload handler - processes the gRPC upload request
handleUpload :: Handle -> IORef Int -> UploadRequest -> IO UploadResponse
handleUpload logHandle counterRef req = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  count <- atomicModifyIORef' counterRef (\n -> (n + 1, n + 1))
  
  -- Phase 1: Validate request structure
  let filenameResult = validateFilename (uploadFilename req)
  let mimeResult = validateMimeType (uploadMimeType req)
  
  case (filenameResult, mimeResult) of
    (Left err, _) -> do
      logValidationFailure logHandle now req "filename" err
      return $ UploadResponse 400 "Invalid filename"
    (_, Left err) -> do
      logValidationFailure logHandle now req "mimetype" err
      return $ UploadResponse 400 "Invalid MIME type"
    (Right safeName, Right safeMime) -> do
      -- Phase 2: Log successful validation with request details
      logUploadAccepted logHandle now req safeName safeMime count
      -- Phase 3: Process upload (simplified)
      return $ UploadResponse 200 "Upload accepted"

-- | Log a validation failure event
logValidationFailure :: Handle -> UTCTime -> UploadRequest -> Text -> Text -> IO ()
logValidationFailure h now req field err = do
  let entry = LogEntry
        { logTimestamp = now
        , logLevel = WARN
        , logSource = "upload.validation"
        , logMessage = T.concat ["Validation failed for field: ", field]
        , logMetadata =
            [ ("request_id", sanitizeField 64 (uploadRequestId req))
            , ("error", sanitizeField 128 err)
            , ("filename", sanitizeField 255 (uploadFilename req))
            ]
        }
  writeAuditLog h entry

-- | Log successful upload acceptance
logUploadAccepted :: Handle -> UTCTime -> UploadRequest -> Text -> Text -> Int -> IO ()
logUploadAccepted h now req safeName safeMime count = do
  let entry = LogEntry
        { logTimestamp = now
        , logLevel = INFO
        , logSource = "upload.accepted"
        , logMessage = T.concat ["Upload #", T.pack (show count), " accepted"]
        , logMetadata =
            [ ("request_id", sanitizeField 64 (uploadRequestId req))
            , ("filename", encodeMetaValue safeName)
            , ("mime_type", encodeMetaValue safeMime)
            , ("size", T.pack (show (uploadSize req)))
            , ("checksum", sanitizeField 64 (uploadChecksum req))
            ]
        }
  writeAuditLog h entry

-- | Initialize the upload service
initService :: FilePath -> IO (Handle, IORef Int)
initService logPath = do
  h <- openFile logPath AppendMode
  hSetBuffering h LineBuffering
  ref <- newIORef 0
  return (h, ref)
